name: Primary Pressure Transmitter Stuck (Channel A)
description: One primary-pressure channel freezes at its current value. Later a real depressurisation begins (a relief valve cracks open). The frozen channel keeps indicating normal pressure while the two healthy channels fall, driving a channel-disagreement alarm.
briefing: Pressure channel A sticks at t+15 s. From t+90 s a relief valve leaks and real primary pressure falls. Determine which channels to trust and whether protection is still bounded.
learning_objectives: A stuck sensor holds its last value regardless of the process
Channel disagreement alarms as the first indication of an instrument fault
Why safety systems use multiple independent channels
Coincident instrument fault + real transient is the hardest case
